headline: Quantum Control, Exact States, and Causality Limits
summary: Today's selection spans experimental and algorithmic advances in quantum computing alongside exact solutions to fundamental quantum field equations. Key results include programmable atom-cavity interfaces, depth-optimized Hamiltonian simulation circuits, and proofs concerning relativistic signaling limits in modified quantum theories.

themes.title: Quantum Hardware and Simulation
themes.body: Advances in quantum control and circuit optimization, ranging from programmable optical tweezer arrays in fiber microcavities to depth-compressed Hamiltonian simulations via fan-out parallelization.

themes.title: Foundations and Quantum Information
themes.body: Studies exploring theoretical thresholds in quantum information, including the mapping of monitored toric codes to Potts models and no-go constraints on relativistic jamming correlations.

themes.title: Wave Equations and Potential Mechanics
themes.body: Exact analytical treatments of quantum wavefunctions, addressing non-linear stabilization against collapse in singular potentials and relativistic Klein-Gordon states in curved spacetime.
